Posting Type 
 Hybrid
 
 
 Job Overview 
WHO WE ARE
Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

WHAT WE DO
At Relativity, engineers don’t just write code. They harness AI tools to architect, optimize, and deliver scalable software faster while shaping the future of legal technology. They design systems that help industries uncover critical insights, ensure compliance, advance access to justice, and continuously evolve our platform using cloud-native architectures, AI capabilities, and modern developer tooling.

Our AI helps power privacy programs, identify confidential information, and detect language indicating misconduct. We are reimagining how legal professionals uncover truth at scale, and engineering is at the heart of that transformation. 
 
 Job Description and Requirements 
 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Design, develop, and operate cloud-based services that enable organizations to manage and process data at scale across multiple platforms 

 Build full-stack features across .NET/C# backend services, React/JavaScript frontends, and SQL data layers that support core product workflows 

 Build and maintain integrations with external systems and internal platform services, including third-party cloud data sources, notification providers, and cross-team APIs 

 Plan and execute service and data migrations, including schema changes, deployment progressions, and feature transitions in live production environments 

 Apply cloud-native patterns including containerization, event-driven architecture, and infrastructure-as-code to deliver scalable and resilient services on Azure 

 Manage and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and independently deploy team-owned services 

 Use observability tooling including structured logging, metrics dashboards, and distributed tracing to investigate production issues and drive system improvements 

 Triage and remediate security vulnerabilities as part of the team’s ongoing security posture efforts 

 Participate in on-call rotations, contribute to incident response activities, and complete follow-up work to support continuous improvement 

 Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and adjacent teams to deliver committed sprint work on a regular cadence 

 
 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 
 Required 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience 

 3+ years of professional software engineering experience 

 Proficiency in C# and .NET, or a comparable object-oriented language with willingness to ramp up on the stack 

 Experience building and operating cloud-based services 

 Ability to work independently through complex features and debug production issues with minimal direction 

 Familiarity with relational databases and SQL, including schema change management 

 
 Preferred 
 Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React for full-stack development 

 Working knowledge of CI/CD pipeline tooling using GitHub Actions 

 Familiarity with observability platforms such as New Relic, Grafana, or equivalent APM and logging tools 

 Exposure to authentication patterns including OAuth2, OIDC, or SAML in enterprise SaaS applications 

 Experience building or maintaining integrations with third-party APIs or enterprise SaaS systems 

 Familiarity with cloud-native concepts such as containerization, event-driven design, or infrastructure-as-code, with Azure experience preferred 

 
 WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT 
 Impactful Mission 
 Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters. 

 Engineering at Scale 
 Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data. 

 Cutting-Edge Technology 
 Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech. 

 Growth and Ownership 
 Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments. 

 Collaborative Culture 
 Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 

 Inclusive Environment 
 Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes. 

 Compensation and Benefits 
 Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program. 

 
 
 
 Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices. 
 
 
 This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives. 
 The expected salary range for this role is between following values: 
160 000 and 240 000PLN 
 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.  
 
 
 Required Skills: 
Engineering Principle, Hardware Integration, Innovation, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, System Designs, Technical Documents, Troubleshooting
